source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive AMIKO_ECO_TC-200_2.3.09_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-01.

simulator.note: Boots as a dual-CPU XIP M3821 board (chips/m3821.py, run_dump_eco_tc200_app_starts.py, run_dump_eco_tc200_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader uses cache-as-RAM until DDR3 is up, drives the CH455 panel on GPIO 128 / 129 ("CH455 panel init OK!", " ON "), parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1016804, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE", 3.38 MB) and maincode(AV) ("22000A882309", 12.74 MB) via LZMA, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE at 0xA6000200 with EBase 0x86002001).  The application attaches PAN_CH455_0 ("---led 455 attach OK--", " on "), initialises hs_config and key database, starts "ali play 1.0 $$$", and renders its 1280x720 OSD dialog through GE_M36F (without the board's anti-clone security IC it displays "SW is not designed for this HW, please change back to offical SW!-----00000000000000 22000a88", like AMIKO HD8155 and AMIKO ALI3606).

desc: Amiko Eco TC-200 (System ID 22000A88) firmware v2.3.09 (2016-12-06) for the compact Full HD DVB-T2/C terrestrial and cable receiver on the ALi M3821A SoC with 128 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.
Pairs an XIP "M3821A 1.1.1" bootloader with a dual-CPU Libcore 13.15.0 maincode(AV) + "M3606 SEE" co-processor build and a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 128 (SCL) / 129 (SDA).
